summary: Safe Bulkers, Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting that Euronext Athens approved the listing and that trading in 12,000,000 new common shares will commence on September 14, 2026, following a private placement via accelerated bookbuilding resolved by the board. Post-issuance, issued capital totals 113,833,473 shares of $0.001 par value. No prospectus was required under Article 1(5)(a) of Regulation (EU) 2017/1129. Piraeus Bank, DNB Carnegie and Fearnley Securities served as Joint Global Coordinators and Joint Bookrunners; Milbank LLP advised the company. This is an ordinary equity listing mechanics notice, not a special situation.
